messages:
sophia: Heads-up — Nova customer escalated: high tail latency + intermittent 503s on Dedicated pool during peak. CSM flagged potential SLA violation, asking for eng commitments. Logs attached in ticket.
micah: Yikes. Which pool/model and timestamps?
sophia: Pool: dedicated-pool-12, model: rw-13b-int8. Window: 2026-03-16 15:12–15:20 UTC. Errors seen: `dispatch timeout`, occasional OOMs on a couple of workers. Paste of relevant lines:
```
[2026-03-16T15:13:02Z] dispatch timeout, req_id=abcd1234, queue_len=987
[2026-03-16T15:14:07Z] OOM on worker-7, gpu_mem=15.2GB/16GB
```
jules: Queue length spiked. Autoscaler didn't add nodes — hitting `max-concurrent-inferences` ceiling (currently 5000). Short-term we can bump limit to 6500.
micah: If we bump, any risk of cascading cost alarms or infra instability? Need SRE approval.
tom: I can approve a temporary bump for 24h while we stabilize. I'll coordinate with infra to avoid noisy autoscale churn. Opening quick PR: `infra/limits#432`.
lina: CSM needs an ETA and a safe workaround they can tell the customer. The customer can't fail over to hosted due to data policies.
sophia: Proposed workaround: route a portion of traffic to a slower/cheaper variant (rw-7b-quant) for 12–24h to reduce pressure. Accuracy loss but keeps latency stable. Need routing change and short KV cache tweaks.
jules: I'll create a canary route with 15% traffic to the slow lane. Terraform plan in ~10m. snippet:
```
resource "redwood_route" "nova_canary" {
  service = "nova-api"
  policy  = { traffic_percent = 15, model = "rw-7b-quant" }
}
```
micah: Also recommend increasing KV cache TTL from 60s -> 300s to avoid repeated context fetches.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: `terraform apply` by jules on `canary-route` (run id: 8921)
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: success in 4m
tom: Limit bump applied (max-concurrent-inferences=6500) — rolling config update now.
micah: After the bump + canary routing, metrics show tail latency down ~45% and error rate back to baseline. Posting Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/in/g/Nova/panel/5678
lina: CSM updated customer: they'll accept the temporary routing + limit bump. Asked for daily status updates.
sophia: Action items and owners:
- Hotpatch limits: tom (done)
- Canary routing: jules (done)
- Temporary KV TTL bump: micah (inflight)
- RCA + root cause for memory pressure & batcher behaviour: micah (ETA: 24h initial findings)
- Customer comms: lina (daily)
Estimated ETA for full fix: 72h. Any objections or other suggestions?
jules: LGTM. I added the infra PR link in the ticket.
micah: Will run heap/profile traces tonight and report back.
tom: Monitoring for 60m then we'll evaluate whether to extend bump.
sophia: Thanks team :thumbsup:
